discovery.geography: Ukraine and international markets on every inhabited continent: Europe, Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Oceania; no Ukraine-only or EU-only source restriction.
discovery.source_registry_status: TARGET_NOT_AUDITED; do not claim 101 sources are connected until an actual deduplicated, accessible and checked registry exists.
discovery.example_media: InVenture (Ukraine); verify actual domain, publication, source and relevance.
discovery.verification: Trace project claims to official announcements or filings; deduplicate syndications. Search independent reporting for relevant context and executive statements, and check each claim against its dated source. Never claim unchecked sources are connected.
discovery.editorial_scope: Industrial energy and generation, metallurgy, food, logistics, data centers, chemical, agriculture, pharma and waste, including relevant financing and implementation technologies.

homepage_news.selection: Five most recent approved, verified, dated articles; sort publication_date descending then stable slug. Never invent news to fill shortfall; other approved articles remain in full listing.

company_context.purpose: Give readers a meaningful, sourced picture of the company investing in or implementing the technology and the actual project site, rather than three generic one-line paragraphs.
company_context.length: Aim for an informative approximately 400–600-character Ukrainian company/project context when evidence supports it; do not pad to a quota. The 600-character limit applies to the compact company-context block, not the full article, evidence notes, executive quotation or source list.
required_information: Company legal or commonly used name, founding year or verified years in operation, headquarters and main business/specialization.

Verified ownership structure or ultimate owner as of a stated date; for a public company distinguish shareholders from management and do not invent a single owner. If ownership is not reliably established, omit it or explicitly say it is not verified.
Exact project site location: city, region/state and country; plant purpose, technology and project stage, distinguishing announcement, construction, commissioning and operation.

Explain why the company or facility matters to industrial energy: confirmed electricity/heat/cooling/backup requirements or stated efficiency measures. If engineering parameters are not published, label any IIG assessment separately and do not attribute it to the company.
research_order: Project primary press release and dedicated project page
Company official About/History/Investor Relations, ownership filings and annual report
Government filings and official local investment or permitting sources
Wikipedia as a discovery/background cross-check only when official material is thin; verify important facts independently and paraphrase rather than copying wording
Credible specialist media and independently sourced interviews
company_context.citations: Record URLs and publication/access dates for factual background, ownership, site, technology and executive statements; retain multiple source links in the full article. Do not use Wikipedia as sole support for a disputed or time-sensitive claim.
company_context.executive_quote: Actively search the project release, company newsroom, official interview and reputable secondary reporting for a relevant direct statement about THIS project by a named CEO, project director, operations executive or authorized official. Quote verbatim in original language, identify full name, role, date and direct source URL, and provide a faithful clearly labelled translation UA/EN when needed. Keep quotations short and within applicable quotation limits. Never fabricate, splice, paraphrase inside quotation marks, or repurpose an unrelated executive quote. If no verified project-specific quotation exists, explicitly mark 'Project-specific executive quotation not found' in internal editorial metadata and publish sourced indirect speech without quotation marks; do not block a factual article solely for lack of a quote.
company_context.full_article: Go beyond the 600-character company profile: develop a sourced narrative covering investment, capacity and technical solution where reported, location, implementation schedule, stage, energy implications and limitations; include a verified executive statement when available, distinguishing source facts from IIG technical analysis. Never invent energy consumption, project KPIs or operating status.

source.supplementary_sources: Use multiple independent/official sources for background and project quotation where available; provide traceable links and dates; do not assume an interview exists.

approved_image_selection_order: Inspect the original primary-source news article and accompanying photograph or media kit for EVERY item.
Use the relevant primary-source photograph first when documented permission covers IIG publication; credit accurately.
Otherwise use the matching sector image from the repository's baze_foto_news collection and manifest; never use another sector's image.
If local image fails, use another rights-cleared image of the same sector or original sector-specific artwork and block release if none renders.
images.repository_asset_gate: Verify nine JPEGs and manifest actually exist in repository and deployment. Extract ZIP to web-accessible files if necessary; ZIP member paths are not browser URLs.
images.source_photo_rule: A hyperlink or attribution alone does not grant republication rights; document license or editorial permission. If unavailable use matching baze_foto_news image.
images.trademark_free_fallback: No company names or logos on generic sector imagery; label as generated representative imagery, never actual company facility.
images.source_priority: Approved relevant primary-source photo takes precedence over generic sector photo.
images.absolute_requirement: Every approved news item displays relevant imagery on TOP-5, full feed, sector listing and full article; no old IIG ENERGY schematic or empty slot.
images.rendering: Responsive 16:9, consistent card heights, object-fit:cover, restrained article hero, accurate UA/EN alt and captions and credit.
images.error_fallback: On source-photo load failure switch to matching verified local baze_foto_news JPEG; never restore SVG placeholder. A missing local image is release-blocking.
images.release_gate: Verify each approved article's source-photo rights or correct sector fallback, live asset URL, bilingual captions, rendered home/news/industry/article images, and five latest approved homepage articles. Policy filenames do not prove upload.

editorial.navigation: Every published card links to full approved article. No hardcoded demo news. Audit nine sectors and honest empty states.
